title: Coral, urchins and sponges
body:
In deeper water you'll be able to find Coral and Urchins. Coral can be used to make Sponges, and Urchins damage you when touched.

Sponges are back to their classic functionality: they create a permanent pocket of air around them until broken. Be careful, though. They can absorb lava, but doing so destroys them.
